lanren.name: 百年榄仁树
lanren.basis: Calibrated on lanshu-1600 (twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.report.json, camera fitted on 37 facade lines, 0.70 px rms). Trunk on the ray through its image centre at 12.0 m from the camera, i.e. (38.9, 17.7): the root flare meets the ground at z 0.6-0.75, the trunk is 1.0 m thick and the low limb tapers as on the photograph only at this distance; the phase-1 position (31, 13, from an aerial blob) put the trunk 8-9 m too far west. Uncertainty about +/- 1.5 m along the view direction, +/- 0.2 m across. Visible limbs (low limb resting on the tall boulder and turning up into a stem, the two limbs rising from it, the leader and two crotch limbs) are back-projected from pixel traces with stated plane assumptions (twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json, tools/lanren_backproject.py); limbs hidden from this view and everything above the frame are estimated to fill the mapped crown.

envelope.basis: crown outline: the sunlit Terminalia crown on the Esri layer of the east side plaza (about x 26-60, y 1-32, centre near 43, 17.5), clipped at the wing facade, at y 32 and where it meets the crown of east_big; heights estimated (no view shows the top of the crown)

limbs.basis: trunk centreline and width (104-120 px) on lanshu-1600, at the calibrated trunk position; crotch at z 4.2-5.0 (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)

the long low limb: leaves the crotch at z 4.0, runs east towards the camera in an S-curve (low points z 2.3 at image x 775 and z 2.15 at x 430-500) to rest on the tall boulder at z 2.3, 8.3 m from the trunk, then turns up into a stem rising from the boulder top (traced to z 4.6 at the top of the frame; above that estimated).  Plane: vertical, through the trunk and the boulder centre; stem in the plane facing the camera through the boulder.  Widths 90 px near the trunk to 50 px at the boulder; the stem is 75 px (0.36 m), thicker than the limb just before the boulder, as on the photograph. (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)
